plan.current_focus: Inspect environment and launch/repair the VM stack with required listeners and control path.
evidence_gaps: No listener evidence for VNC or nginx yet.
No evidence of programmatic keyboard control path yet.
No evidence of Windows desktop-ready state yet.
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed command output showing QEMU launched with snapshot mode and VNC :1/5901.
Receipt-backed probe showing nginx on port 80.
Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard control path being configured or exercised.
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent desktop-ready state.
implementation_approach: Discover available tooling and any existing launch scripts/configuration.
Start QEMU with /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode, VNC :1 (5901), and a keyboard-control interface suitable for automation.
Start nginx on port 80 as a web interface for remote access.
Keep QEMU running in the background and capture receipts for launch and listener probes.
Use a programmatic keyboard path to send keystrokes and verify the VM responds.
Confirm the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent desktop-ready state via VNC/console evidence.
known_bad_behavior: Mutable disk mode instead of snapshot mode.
Assuming process start equals service readiness.
Treating VNC or nginx start as sufficient without listener probes.
next_steps: Inspect filesystem and available launch artifacts.
Launch or repair the VM stack.
Probe listeners and exercise keyboard control.
plan.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU snapshot mode, expose VNC on :1/5901 and nginx on port 80, keep VM backgrounded, and verify a programmatic keyboard control path plus desktop-ready state.
risks: QEMU or nginx may not be installed or may require alternate invocation.
Windows 3.11 may need manual interaction to reach desktop.
Need to preserve immutable base image via snapshot mode.
validation_strategy: Inspect logs/receipts for snapshot mode and image path.
Exercise programmatic keyboard input and verify response.
verification_test_strategy: Use service probes for port 5901 and port 80.
Use raw shell commands only as needed to inspect process args and logs.
Avoid repeating equivalent checks without new evidence.
